vintage: American Time Use Survey, 2025 annual averages
title: Time spent in primary activities: sleeping, civilian population
universe: Civilian noninstitutional population 15 and over (Table 1); 18 and over, employed or not employed, by presence of a household child under 18 (Tables 8B and 8C)
limits: Average hours per diary day over every day of the year (weekdays, weekends and holidays together), not hours on days worked; sleeping includes naps and spells of sleeplessness. Table 8B gives no total for all employed adults, only with and without a household child. Leisure by age (Table 3) is already held in src/core2/data/time-use-reference.json and is not repeated here. bls.gov refuses scripted requests (HTTP 403 to curl); the pages were read through a fetch tool.
